name: Introduction and overview — Borei-class Submarine — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Borei-class Submarine
description: Introduction and overview of the Borei-class Submarine: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. Russia's Borei class — 7+ built and in production — is the new backbone of the Russian sea-based deterrent, each carrying 16 Bulava ballistic missiles. Quieter and more modern than the Typhoons and Deltas they replace, Boreis serve the Northern and Pacific fleets. Baseline facts: Russian ballistic-missile submarine; 7+ built; 16 Bulava missiles each..
